scenario: Bought 1 Mar 2023 for 20,000 on a PCP, sold 1 Mar 2026 for 11,000; today is 1 Sep 2026
derivation: Spec 7.7 Cost of ownership. Period: purchase date to sale date, both inclusive (1 Mar 2023 to 1 Mar 2026); a sold vehicle's figures are exact lifetime figures and the sale ends both periods.

Running costs, the ledger lines dated in the period: fuel 600 + 700 + 800 = 2,100; maintenance 450 + 350 = 800; insurance documents 732 + 730 + 730 = 2,192 (counted on their ledger date, spec 7.35); finance 99.

Finance (spec 7.32): a PCP counts only credit charges, never capital. At 0% APR the interest is 0, so the only line is the 99 documentation fee on the first payment date (1 Apr 2023). The 2,000 deposit, 36 x 250 and the 9,000 final payment are capital: the 20,000 price is already counted through depreciation. The final payment falls after the sale and is outside the period in any case.
Running = 2,100 + 800 + 2,192 + 99 = 5,191 over 9 entries (3 fill-ups, 2 services, 3 documents, 1 fee).
Depreciation (spec 7.1): price paid 20,000 - sale price 11,000 = 9,000 lost over exactly 36 months = 3,000 a year. Total = 5,191 + 9,000 = 14,191.
Distance: readings 10,000 mi on 1 Mar 2023 and 60,000 mi on 1 Mar 2026 = 50,000 mi = 80,467.2 km (1 mi = 1.609344 km).

Per km, kept to 6 places: running 5,191 / 80,467.2 = 0.064511; depreciation 9,000 / 80,467.2 = 0.111847; together 0.176358 a km = 0.176358 x 1.609344 = 0.283821 a mile, shown 0.284/mi (CSV running 0.10382, depreciation 0.18).
Per month (spec 7.7): the period touches 37 calendar months (Mar 2023 to Mar 2026): running 5,191 / 37 = 140.297; depreciation 3,000 / 12 = 250; together 390.297, shown 390.30.

Years (spec 7.35): an insurance document is spread by day over its cover, 2 a day for each of the three (366, 365 and 365 days at 732, 730 and 730): 2023 = 306 days = 612; 2024 = 60 + 306 days = 120 + 612 = 732; 2025 = 59 + 306 days = 118 + 612 = 730; 2026 to 1 Mar = 59 days = 118. Total 2,192 = since bought.

Years' depreciation is a straight line from 20,000 on 1 Mar 2023 to 11,000 on 1 Mar 2026 (1,096 days, 9,000 / 1,096 a day): 2023 from 1 Mar to the end of 31 Dec = 306 days = 2,512.774; 2024 = 366 days = 3,005.474; 2025 = 365 days = 2,997.263; 2026 to 1 Mar = 59 days = 484.489; they add up to 9,000.
The 99 fee is in 2023. Fuel falls in the year of each fill-up; services on their dates (2024: 450, 2025: 350).

page: Total: £5,191.00 of running costs + £9,000.00 of depreciation = £14,191.00.
